chunks: It was said to him: 'Enter Paradise.' He said: 'If only my people knew!'
ai.seo_question: What did the righteous servant say when told to enter Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the righteous servant of the People of the City (Qarun's contemporary) or the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), emphasizing the profound sorrow of the righteous when their community fails to recognize divine truth. It underscores the concept of *shafa'ah* (intercession) and the enduring hope that the faithful may yet witness the ultimate validation of their message in the Hereafter.
